arguments.name: url
arguments.description: Full URL to send logs to.

arguments.name: batch_size
arguments.description: Maximum batch size of logs to accumulate before sending.

arguments.name: batch_wait
arguments.description: Maximum amount of time to wait before sending a batch.

arguments.name: bearer_token_file
arguments.description: File containing a bearer token to authenticate with.

arguments.name: bearer_token
arguments.description: Bearer token to authenticate with.

arguments.name: enable_http2
arguments.description: Whether HTTP2 is supported for requests.

arguments.name: follow_redirects
arguments.description: Whether redirects returned by the server should be followed.

arguments.name: http_headers
arguments.description: Custom HTTP headers to be sent along with each request. The map key is the header name.

arguments.name: headers
arguments.description: Extra headers to deliver with the request.

arguments.name: max_backoff_period
arguments.description: Maximum backoff time between retries.

arguments.name: max_backoff_retries
arguments.description: Maximum number of retries.

arguments.name: min_backoff_period
arguments.description: Initial backoff time between retries.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Optional name to identify this endpoint with.

arguments.name: no_proxy
arguments.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses, CIDR notations, and domain names to exclude from proxying.

arguments.name: proxy_connect_header
arguments.description: Specifies headers to send to proxies during CONNECT requests.

arguments.name: proxy_from_environment
arguments.description: Use the proxy URL indicated by environment variables.

arguments.name: proxy_url
arguments.description: HTTP proxy to send requests through.

arguments.name: remote_timeout
arguments.description: Timeout for requests made to the URL.

arguments.name: retry_on_http_429
arguments.description: Retry when an HTTP 429 status code is received.

arguments.name: tenant_id
arguments.description: The tenant ID used by default to push logs.
